Test Case Title: Verify Activities Link is Present in Navigation
Steps: 1. Open https://www.district.in/. 2. Look for Activities link in the top navigation bar.
Expected Result: Activities link is visible in the navigation bar.

Test Case Title: Verify Clicking Activities Navigates to Activities Page
Steps: 1. Open https://www.district.in/. 2. Click the Activities link in the navigation bar. 3. Check the current URL.
Expected Result: Browser navigates to https://www.district.in/activities/.

Test Case Title: Verify Activities Page Displays Activity Cards
Preconditions: User is on the Activities page.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.district.in/activities/. 2. Observe the list of activity cards on the page.
Expected Result: At least one activity card is visible showing name and price.

Test Case Title: Verify This Weekend Filter Button is Present on Activities Page
Preconditions: User is on the Activities page.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.district.in/activities/. 2. Look for the This Weekend button in the quick filters row.
Expected Result: This Weekend filter button is visible on the page.

Test Case Title: Verify Clicking This Weekend Filter Refreshes the List
Preconditions: User is on the Activities page.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.district.in/activities/. 2. Click the This Weekend filter button. 3. Wait for the page to refresh.
Expected Result: Activity list refreshes and the This Weekend button appears selected/highlighted.

Test Case Title: Verify Activities List is Not Empty After This Weekend Filter
Preconditions: User is on the Activities page.
Steps: 1. Click the This Weekend filter button. 2. Count the number of activity cards displayed.
Expected Result: At least one activity is shown after applying the filter.

Test Case Title: Verify This Weekend Filter Shows Weekend Dates on Cards
Steps: 1. Apply This Weekend filter. 2. Read the date text on the first visible activity card.
Expected Result: The date shown on the activity card falls on a Saturday or Sunday.

Test Case Title: Verify Filters Button Opens Sort Panel
Preconditions: User is on the Activities page with This Weekend filter applied.
Steps: 1. Click the Filters button on the Activities page. 2. Check if the sort options appear.
Expected Result: Filter panel opens and shows Sort By options including Price: Low to High.

Test Case Title: Verify Price Low to High Sort Option is Selectable
Steps: 1. Open the Filters panel. 2. Click the Price: Low to High radio button under Sort By.
Expected Result: Price: Low to High radio button gets selected.

Test Case Title: Verify Activities are Reordered After Applying Price Sort
Preconditions: User selected Price: Low to High sort.
Steps: 1. Select Price: Low to High. 2. Click Apply Filters. 3. Read the price of the first and second activity cards.
Expected Result: First activity price is less than or equal to the second activity price.

Test Case Title: Verify Filter Panel Closes After Clicking Apply Filters
Preconditions: Filters panel is open with sort selected.
Steps: 1. Select Price: Low to High. 2. Click Apply Filters button.
Expected Result: Filter panel closes and the Activities page with sorted results is displayed.

Test Case Title: Verify Activity Name is Extracted from Each Card
Steps: 1. Apply This Weekend filter and Price: Low to High sort. 2. Get the text of the activity name element from each card.
Expected Result: Activity names are captured as non-empty strings for each visible card.

Test Case Title: Verify Activity Price is Extracted from Each Card
Steps: 1. Apply This Weekend filter and Price: Low to High sort. 2. Get the text of the price element from each card.
Expected Result: Prices are captured in rupee format (e.g. Rs.176) for each visible card.

Test Case Title: Verify Activity Venue is Extracted from Each Card
Steps: 1. Apply This Weekend filter and Price: Low to High sort. 2. Get the text of the venue element from each card.
Expected Result: Venue names are captured as non-empty strings for each visible card.

Test Case Title: Verify All Extracted Data is Stored in a Java Collection
Steps: 1. Extract name venue and price from each card. 2. Store each activity as a map in a List. 3. Print the list size.
Expected Result: List size equals the number of activity cards visible on the page.

Test Case Title: Verify Lowest Price Activity is the First Item After Sort
Preconditions: Activities sorted by Price: Low to High.
Steps: 1. Extract prices from all activity cards. 2. Compare the first card price with all others.
Expected Result: The first activity card has the lowest price among all extracted activities.

Test Case Title: Verify Lowest Price Activity Details are Printed to Console
Steps: 1. Get the activity at index 0 from the collection. 2. Print its name venue and price to the console.
Expected Result: Console output shows the name venue and price of the first activity in the sorted list.

Test Case Title: Verify Printed Activity Price is a Valid Numeric Value
Preconditions: Activity at index 0 details are printed.
Steps: 1. Extract the price text from the lowest price activity. 2. Parse the numeric value from the text. 3. Verify it is greater than zero.
Expected Result: The extracted numeric price value is greater than zero.

Test Case Title: Verify Movies Link is Present in Navigation
Steps: 1. Open https://www.district.in/. 2. Look for the Movies link in the top navigation bar.
Expected Result: Movies link is visible in the navigation bar.

Test Case Title: Verify Clicking Movies Navigates to Movies Page
Steps: 1. Open https://www.district.in/. 2. Click the Movies link. 3. Check the current URL.
Expected Result: Browser navigates to https://www.district.in/movies/.

Test Case Title: Verify Movies Page Displays Movie Cards
Preconditions: User is on the Movies page.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.district.in/movies/. 2. Observe the list of movie cards.
Expected Result: At least one movie card is visible showing a movie title.

Test Case Title: Verify Filters Button Opens Filter Panel on Movies Page
Preconditions: User is on the Movies page.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.district.in/movies/. 2. Click the Filters button.
Expected Result: Filter panel opens showing Genre Language and Format sections.

Test Case Title: Verify Language Section is Present in Movies Filter Panel
Steps: 1. Open the Filters panel on the Movies page. 2. Look for the Language section/heading.
Expected Result: Language section is visible inside the filter panel.
Notes: Section heading text must be Language

Test Case Title: Verify Language Options are Extracted from the Filter Panel
Steps: 1. Open Filters panel. 2. Find all language checkbox or option elements in the Language section. 3. Get their text.
Expected Result: A list of language names is captured (e.g. Hindi English Marathi Tamil). List has at least 2 entries.

Test Case Title: Verify Extracted Language List is Printed to Console
Steps: 1. Extract all language names into a List<String>. 2. Print each language name to the console.
Expected Result: All language names are printed to the console with no empty entries.
Notes: Use a loop to print each item

Test Case Title: Verify User Avatar Button is Present in Navigation
Steps: 1. Open https://www.district.in/. 2. Look for the User Avatar icon in the top-right corner.
Expected Result: User Avatar button is visible and interactable in the navigation bar.

Test Case Title: Verify Clicking User Avatar Opens Login Modal
Preconditions: User is not logged in. Any district.in page is open.
Steps: 1. Open https://www.district.in/. 2. Click the User Avatar button.
Expected Result: Login modal appears with a mobile number input field and a Continue button.

Test Case Title: Verify Login Modal Contains Required UI Elements
Steps: 1. Open login modal. 2. Check for the mobile number input field country code +91 and Continue button.
Expected Result: Mobile number input field country code +91 and Continue button are all visible in the modal.

Test Case Title: Verify Error is Shown for Empty Mobile Number
Steps: 1. Open login modal. 2. Leave the mobile number field empty. 3. Click the Continue button.
Expected Result: An error message or validation warning is displayed. User remains on the login modal.

Test Case Title: Verify Error is Shown for Short Mobile Number
Steps: 1. Open login modal. 2. Enter 12345 in the mobile number field. 3. Click the Continue button.
Expected Result: An error message is displayed near the input field. No OTP screen is shown.

Test Case Title: Verify Error Message Text is Captured by Automation
Preconditions: Login modal shows error after invalid input.
Steps: 1. Enter 12345. 2. Click Continue. 3. Get the text of the error message element. 4. Print it to console.
Expected Result: Error message text is captured as a non-empty string and printed to the console.
Notes: Use getText() on the error element

Test Case Title: Verify User Stays on Login Modal After Invalid Submission
Steps: 1. Enter 999 in the mobile number field. 2. Click Continue. 3. Check if the mobile number input is still visible.
Expected Result: Mobile number input field is still visible. No navigation to OTP or new page has occurred.

Test Case Title: Verify Screenshot is Taken After Error Message Appears
Steps: 1. Enter 12345. 2. Click Continue. 3. Wait for error message to appear. 4. Take a screenshot using TakesScreenshot.
Expected Result: A screenshot file is saved to the configured directory without any error.
Notes: File must exist after test run

Test Case Title: Verify Screenshot File is Saved with a Valid Name
Steps: 1. Run the login error test. 2. Take screenshot. 3. Save file to screenshots folder. 4. Check if file exists at the saved path.
Expected Result: The screenshot file exists at the saved path and is not zero bytes in size.

Test Case Title: Verify Screenshot Shows the Login Error Message
Steps: 1. Take screenshot after error is displayed. 2. Open the saved image (manual verification step).
Expected Result: The screenshot visually shows the login modal with the error message text visible.
